facts.text: In early June the lower trail can still be dusted with fresh snow and the upper slope below the rim is icy enough that crampons and an axe get used.
By early October mornings at the trailhead freeze hard and frost coats the rocks, and the first dry flurries can arrive by afternoon, though the route is largely bare.
Biting insects are heavy below treeline in mid-July
The small tarn at the foot of the Lewis Glacier is a spot to refill water in August; filter it.
After gaining the crater rim, the true summit is across the crater on the far side, so allow for the extra walk along the rim.

notes: Our seven routes match Mountain Project South Sister list exactly, so none missing. Green Lakes (south ridge via Green Lakes/Moraine) and the Northwest Ridge are logged variants but I could not fetch a page naming them as separate routes (SummitPost and a trip-report site returned 403), so no missing entries. or_old_crater_route and or_north_ridge have no summit pins; none proposed. Packet has no North Ridge tracks.
